title: True Blue Account: Cash Management Dashboard
summary: This document explains the True Blue Account Cash Management Dashboard (included at no additional cost) for creating and managing bulk payment templates. It covers saving up to $100 bulk payment templates, creating payroll/vendor/recurring templates, assigning approval roles, reusing templates, and troubleshooting missing features by confirming access and refreshing the session.
faqs: Is the Cash Management Dashboard included in the True Blue Account, or is there an extra cost?
How many bulk payment templates can I save (and what is the $100 allowance)?
How do I use the dashboard for high-volume activity like payroll runs and vendor batches?
Can I assign approval roles before releasing payments using a template?
What best practices should I follow for managing templates (naming, review/inactive/archiving, validating recipients)?
If I can’t see dashboard features, what should I do to troubleshoot access? (refresh session and confirm access is enabled)
